proposals.issue_title: Silent GHA Minute Exhaustion via API Rate Limits
proposals.current_pain_description: If Together AI or Cloudflare Workers AI hit rate limits (429) or quota limits, GHA workflows will hang, retry indefinitely, or fail late, wasting precious free GHA runner minutes (2000/month limit).
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a lightweight pre-flight API checker step in GitHub Actions. If a 5-second test request to the target API returns 429 or 401, immediately exit the workflow gracefully with status 'success' (not 'failed' to prevent email alert spam) and log the block.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents GHA account suspensions and preserves free run minutes for active pipelines.

proposals.issue_title: Fragile Image Generation Silos and Lack of Fallback
proposals.current_pain_description: Each image pipeline manually handles its API requests. If Pollinations has low quality, or Gemini is rate-limited, the pipeline crashes instead of switching to alternative providers.
proposals.proposed_fix: Refactor image generation into a single unified helper module (`image_service.py`) with a standardized parameter schema. Implement a strict priority chain: Cloudflare Workers AI (Free) -> Together AI (Free) -> Runware (PAYG, if balance > 0) -> Pollinations (Fallback).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero pipeline failures due to image API downtime; optimal selection of best free image providers automatically.

proposals.issue_title: Mobile Upload Bottleneck (The Phone-Only Last Mile)
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates only on an Android phone. Extracting generated assets, copy-pasting descriptions, tags, and pricing from raw JSON files to upload to Redbubble/KDP via mobile browser is tedious and error-prone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add an automated packaging step at the end of each production pipeline. Generate a single ZIP file containing the assets, plus a highly-readable 'UPLOAD_MANIFEST.txt' tailored for mobile screen copy-pasting (clean emoji-bulleted tags, short titles, pre-calculated prices). Store this ZIP in GHA artifacts.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Cuts manual mobile publishing time per product from 15 minutes to under 3 minutes.

proposals.issue_title: Git History Bloat from Generated Heavy Assets
proposals.current_pain_description: Committing raw PNG/PDF assets directly into the GitHub repository quickly reaches GitHub's 1GB/2GB soft repository size limit, risking account flags or slow git pulls on Termux.
proposals.proposed_fix: Configure GHA to never commit raw output images back to the main branch. Instead, upload high-res outputs strictly as GHA Artifacts (stored free for 90 days) or compile them directly into compressed WebP formats before any commit is made.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents repository bloat, maintains fast `git pull` speeds on Termux, and avoids GitHub TOS warnings.

proposals.issue_title: Debris, Grey Gradients, and Unfillable Spaces in Coloring Books
proposals.current_pain_description: Raw outputs from FLUX or SDXL often contain grey shading, sketchy lines, and semi-colored regions that look unprofessional and are impossible to color physically.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add an automated Python post-processing script using `Pillow` and `OpenCV`. Run a binary thresholding filter (adaptive thresholding) to force pixels to absolute black or absolute white, and apply a mild bilateral filter to smooth out jagged lines.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures clean, high-contrast, professional-looking line art ready for KDP printing without manual GIMP/Photoshop touchups.

proposals.current_pain_description: Assets generated for a merch design are discarded after the run, missing the chance to reuse the prompt or the base vector in other product types.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a lightweight metadata database (`assets_vault.json`) in the repository. When a high-quality asset is approved, log its metadata, tag keywords, and prompts. Allow other pipelines (e.g., coloring books, tumbler wraps) to query this vault to dynamically generate matching sister products.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 1 design effort automatically turns into 4 distinct product listings, multiplying ROI per hour worked.
